journey.name: bottom_navigation
journey.description: Switch between the Home, Contacts, and Favorites tabs and verify each screen shows

actions.action: Tap "Contacts" in the bottom navigation bar. Verify a large blue face icon is shown in the center of the screen and the top bar title becomes "Contacts"
Tap "Favorites" in the bottom navigation bar. Verify a large blue heart icon is shown in the center of the screen and the top bar title becomes "Favorites"
Tap "Home" in the bottom navigation bar. Verify the top bar title becomes "Home" and a scrollable list of buttons and numbered items is shown
